purpose: Freeze, append-only, the correction to the ONE blocker the W2-03/W2-04 focused adversarial closure audit found (CONDITIONAL_PASS): the static 'managed-role-bootstrap-ready' release gate in tests/eval/stella-release/hosted-release-gate.ts became vacuous after HPO-ODS-W2-03 moved every executable CREATE/ALTER ROLE statement out of stella_hosted_0001_managed_role_bootstrap.sql into stella_hosted_0000_managed_role_identity_bootstrap.sql. The gate still read only stella_hosted_0001, so its role-attribute scan (BYPASSRLS/SUPERUSER/CREATEROLE-on-statement) iterates zero statements and can no longer catch anything. This is purely a STATIC TEST-INFRASTRUCTURE correction: no provisioning, runtime, role-topology, migration or B1-Evidence semantics are touched, and neither the 64-unit rehearsal nor the B1 semantic audit is reopened.
scope_note: APPEND-ONLY AUTHORITY. Does not rewrite, supersede, reinterpret or restate ODS_V1_AUTHORITY_v1.0.0.json, ODS_V1_MAINTENANCE_ADDENDUM_v1.0.1 through v1.0.5, ODS_V1_OPERATIONAL_CLOSURE_v1.0.0.json, ODS_V1_EFFICIENCY_VALIDATION_v1.0.0.json, or any FIB/PC-01B/IM-01B artifact. HPO-ODS-W2-01 through W2-04 are FROZEN_UNCHANGED.

predecessor_authorities.source_audit: W2-03-W2-04-FOCUSED-ADVERSARIAL-CLOSURE-AUDIT, result CONDITIONAL_PASS, sole blocker: managed-role-bootstrap-ready static release gate vacuity

phase_1_read_only_fact_derivation.prior_read_surface: buildHostedGateEvidence read ONLY db/prepared/stella_hosted_0001_managed_role_bootstrap.sql into a single `bootstrapSql` field; the gate's ROLE_STATEMENT scan (/\b(CREATE|ALTER)\s+ROLE\b[^;]*/gi) ran exclusively against that field's executable (comment-stripped) text.
phase_1_read_only_fact_derivation.derivation_method: comment-stripped text (same executableLines discipline the gate itself and tests/hosted/managed-compatibility.test.ts already use), matched against the gate's own ROLE_STATEMENT regex, counted independently outside any test file.
phase_1_read_only_fact_derivation.vacuity_live_reproduction: npx vitest run tests/eval/stella-release/hosted-release-gate.test.ts — 1 of 30 tests fails: 'managed-role-bootstrap-ready FAILS if the bootstrap would grant BYPASSRLS'. Root cause: the mutation's global regex replace touches a single stray comment occurrence of the literal token NOBYPASSRLS at line 942 of stella_hosted_0001 (unrelated prose), which the executable-line filter then strips before the ROLE_STATEMENT scan ever runs — so the mutated evidence is indistinguishable from the unmutated evidence by the time the gate inspects it, and the gate PASSES when the test requires FAIL.
runtime_enforcement_confirmed_present_el: db/prepared/stella_hosted_0000_managed_role_identity_bootstrap.sql §5 (Self-verification) — refuses any of the five roles holding a dangerous attribute, at APPLY time, in the transaction that creates them
db/prepared/stella_hosted_0001_managed_role_bootstrap.sql §0 (E0) — refuses, at APPLY time, if the five identities are absent or their attributes/memberships have drifted from the canonical shape
db/hosted/baseline-postconditions.ts B0-09-roles — refuses, at CHECKPOINT B0 time, any uellix_* role beyond the exact five canonical identities
phase_1_read_only_fact_derivation.conclusion: The static release gate is the ONLY place this property was checked WITHOUT ever running Postgres — a repository-only signal for CI/pre-flight. Its vacuity does not weaken any live enforcement (all three runtime checks above remain intact and were exercised by the real isolated-cluster rehearsal), but it does mean a future edit to stella_hosted_0000 that reintroduced BYPASSRLS would ship past this specific gate undetected until a real apply. That is the narrow gap this authority closes.

HPO-ODS-W2-05.title: REPOINT_MANAGED_ROLE_RELEASE_GATE_TO_CANONICAL_IDENTITY_SOURCE
HPO-ODS-W2-05.rule: buildHostedGateEvidence must read role-definition/attribute evidence from db/prepared/stella_hosted_0000_managed_role_identity_bootstrap.sql (the canonical single source of role identity, per HPO-ODS-W2-03) as its own distinct evidence field, separate from stella_hosted_0001's post-baseline bootstrap/verifier text. The gate must attribute each piece of evidence to the source responsible for it: role-definition statements (CREATE/ALTER ROLE, and the BYPASSRLS/SUPERUSER/CREATEROLE-per-statement scan) come from 0000; the superuser-refusal and post-baseline assertion text remain 0001's own concern; the service_role-as-grantee sweep covers both sources, since either could in principle name it. The gate must also positively assert 0001 contains ZERO executable CREATE/ALTER ROLE statements — role identity has exactly one source, and reintroducing a role definition into 0001 is itself a gate failure, not merely a redundancy.
HPO-ODS-W2-05.non_vacuity_requirement: Every control this authority requires must be demonstrated non-vacuous: a positive count of executable role statements discovered from 0000, a positive count of executable NOBYPASSRLS evidence discovered from 0000, and an explicit test proving that pointing the evidence builder back at 0001-only (the pre-fix shape) makes the SAME tests fail — i.e. the test suite itself would have caught the regression this authority fixes, not merely re-implemented it with different plumbing.

any change to provisioning phase order or db/hosted/hosted-provisioning-runner.ts

any change to B1 Evidence files or a rerun of the B1 semantic audit
a rehearsal artifact refresh (no runtime/provisioning SQL changes, so artifacts/baseline-rehearsal/latest.json is untouched)
